column18: The cells bordered in red are those which give you odds for standard gameplay in which you do not flash the nextbox or push down. Notes explain briefly how to survive each level.

column18: The first five columns are for clears during the level. The second five columns are for clears entering a level.

column16: Singles are a MAJOR risk. Flash nextbox to save it if one is taken.
column18: Levels are groups of 4 rows. Each row represents a different amount of lines cleared.

The "clear count" column, unless you want to mentally count your number of each type of line clear, is going to be unknowable to the player. You can play as if there's a 10% chance your odds are drawn from that column instead of the standard column. If you complete an entire level in singles, that column *will* be used at least once.

column16: Do not single at transition. Further singles are a minor risk due to clear count. Next box will save.

column18: The final 3 columns are used for crashes involving no line clears. The columns are broken into the 3 categories of pieces that determine whether the game will crash. hZ means horizontal Z, vZ means vertical Z. In those levels, the 4 rows are used like the columns are in the early parts of the sheet.

column16: You're safe until 166. Singles are always safe from here.
